resources.string: A lock may be blocking mobile service
SIM %1$d cannot connect to the mobile network right now. The band or cell you locked may be out of range. Clear both locks to let your phone find a network automatically.
Please wait while the band and cell locks on SIM %1$d are cleared.
SIM %1$d may still have active locks. Try again or check the status in Band and Cell Control.
Locks cleared. Your phone is looking for a network…

Band and cell locks on SIM %1$d are cleared, but your phone still cannot connect. Swipe down to open Quick Settings, turn on Airplane mode, wait a few seconds, then turn it off and let your phone search again. Wait until any call ends first, since Airplane mode briefly interrupts calls and mobile data.
